definitions.explanation: A person one works with at the same company or organization.

examples.japanese: {同僚|どうりょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
{同僚|どうりょう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{昼|ひる}ごはん→昼ご飯：02950_hirugohan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べました→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I had lunch with my colleague.

examples.japanese: {同僚|どうりょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦{親切|しんせつ}→親切：01144_shinsetsu⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{同僚|どうりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}ってきました→入る：00494_hairu⟧。

{同僚|どうりょう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{飲|の}み→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{毎週|まいしゅう}→毎週：00730_maishuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ありません→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I sometimes go drinking with colleagues after work, but not every week.

notes:
{同僚|どうりょう} refers to coworkers at a similar level in the same organization.

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{同|どう}→同〜：03962_dou⟧ (same) + ⟦{僚|りょう}→僚：noentry⟧ (companion)

USAGE:
{同僚|どうりょう} specifically means peers or equals at work. It does not include:
- ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧: superiors, bosses
- ⟦{部下|ぶか}→部下：06453_buka⟧: subordinates

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {同僚|どうりょう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧: to work with colleagues
- ⟦{元|もと}→元：03878_moto⟧{同僚|どうりょう}: former colleague
- {同僚|どうりょう}⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧: colleague relationship

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {同僚|どうりょう}: colleague (same organization, peer level)
- ⟦{仲間|なかま}→仲間：03498_nakama⟧: companion, member of a group
- ⟦{同期|どうき}→同期：12029_douki⟧: someone who joined at the same time
